lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Before we start the day, we need to decide who's doing what. The laundry, bathroom, groceries, dishes, and recycling are all still on the list.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Right. Whose turn is it to clean the bathroom?

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: I think it's your turn to clean it. I did it last weekend.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: You're right. And I thought you were supposed to take the recycling downstairs.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: I am. I also have to pick up the groceries before noon.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Sorry, what was that? I didn't catch the time.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Before noon. The pickup time is between eleven and twelve.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Got it. I have to finish my lesson plans this morning, but I can take the recycling down first if that helps.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: That would help, thanks. Then you're taking the recycling.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Thanks. I'm supposed to start the laundry, right?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Yes, and I'm doing the dishes after breakfast.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Just to check, you mean unloading the clean dishes first?

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Exactly. Then I'll load the breakfast dishes. Do you want to trade the bathroom for the laundry?

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: No, let's keep those two as they are. You have three tasks, and I have two, but the grocery trip takes longer.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Fair enough. So you're picking up the groceries and doing the laundry, and I'm cleaning the bathroom, doing the dishes, and taking out the recycling, right?

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Almost. We need to fold the laundry together after lunch.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Let me make sure I've got this right: I have the bathroom, dishes, and recycling. You have the groceries and laundry. We fold everything together.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: That's it. Now the list is clear.
